name: High-Efficiency Plate Heat Exchanger AQ/AA
full_description: The AQ/AA Series is an AHRI-certified gasketed plate-and-frame heat exchanger designed for HVAC-R refrigeration systems. Accessen describes the series as optimized for variable-load heat transfer performance, compatibility with different water qualities and temperatures, and application-specific configuration through multi-angle chevron plates, varied channel depths, and configurable aspect ratios within standardized port sizes.

details.title: What applications is the AQ/AA series designed for?
details.content: Accessen positions the AQ/AA Series for HVAC-R refrigeration systems where certified liquid-to-liquid heat exchanger performance and adaptable thermal design are important.

details.title: How does the design remain flexible?
details.content: The series uses multi-angle chevron plates, different channel depths, and configurable aspect ratios within standard port sizes so that designs can be adapted to different duties and operating conditions.

seo_data.meta_description: AHRI-certified gasketed plate-and-frame heat exchanger for HVAC-R refrigeration systems with configurable plate geometry and high heat transfer efficiency.
